blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — The Agusan del Sur National High School (ASNHS) has ramped up its campus security measures, including stricter gate inspections and closer coordination with authorities, following recent incidents of violence in schools. In a public advisory, ASNHS assured parents and the community that it is taking proactive steps to maintain a safe, peaceful, and conducive learning environment for students and school personnel. The advisory was written in the Bisaya language to ensure that parents and community members who are not fluent in English can easily understand the school’s message.
